about: Canonical ingredient vocabulary. Every drink in the database references these IDs. Chemistry values: abv = % alcohol by volume; sugar = grams of sugar per 100 ml; acid = grams of acid (citric-equivalent) per 100 ml. Values follow Dave Arnold's Liquid Intelligence tables where available and label/industry estimates otherwise. avail: common (any decent liquor store/grocery), specialty (well-stocked shop or online, not expensive), homemade (trivial to make from common ingredients), rare (hard to find), defunct (no longer produced). cost: 1 cheap .. 4 expensive (per bottle/unit relative to category).

unit_notes.top: Soda/sparkling top-up; analysis assumes 2 oz unless an amount is given.
unit_notes.piece: Whole items (banana, strawberry, egg white). Volume taken from the ingredient's oz_per_piece.
unit_notes.garnish: Flavor-relevant garnish that is part of the drink's taste (grated nutmeg, swizzled mint). Zero volume.

roles.base: Primary spirit(s) that carry the drink.
roles.modifier: Liqueurs / fortified wines: sweetness + flavor + some alcohol.
roles.juice: Fruit juices/nectars: body, low acid, fruit character.
roles.rich: Creams, coconut, egg, dairy: texture and fat.
roles.accent: Potent flavorings used by the dash or barspoon (bitters, absinthe).
roles.lengthener: Soda, sparkling wine, coffee, water: volume and effervescence.
roles.aromatic: Zero-volume herbs/spices/garnishes that carry flavor (mint, nutmeg).

ingredients.name: Light rum (column still, Cuban/Puerto Rican style)
ingredients.notes: The 'light Puerto Rican / Cuban rum' of classic specs. Martin Cate category: column still lightly aged.

ingredients.name: Gold rum (lightly aged column still, Spanish style)
ingredients.notes: The 'gold Puerto Rican rum' in many Don the Beachcomber specs.

ingredients.name: Aged Spanish-style rum
ingredients.notes: Column still aged. Dry, oaky, elegant.

ingredients.name: Lightly aged blended rum (pot + column)
ingredients.notes: A white rum with a little pot-still character. The modern tiki bar's default light rum.

ingredients.name: Barbados rum (blended, aged)
ingredients.notes: Balanced pot/column blend. Don's 'Barbados rum'. The diplomat of the rum shelf.

ingredients.name: Jamaican rum (blended, aged)
ingredients.notes: Don's 'gold Jamaican rum'; the modern stand-in for Wray & Nephew 17 (original Mai Tai rum, defunct).

ingredients.name: Dark Jamaican rum
ingredients.notes: Caramel-colored, molasses-forward. Classic Planter's Punch rum.

ingredients.name: Jamaican pot-still rum (aged, high proof)
ingredients.notes: High-ester 'hogo'. A half ounce changes everything.

ingredients.name: Jamaican unaged overproof rum
ingredients.notes: Raw, estery, loud. Use sparingly.

ingredients.name: Demerara rum (Guyana)
ingredients.notes: Burnt sugar and smoke from wooden stills. Don the Beachcomber's backbone rum.

ingredients.name: Demerara 151 overproof rum
ingredients.notes: The Zombie's float. Flammable; never float-and-light in a glass you care about.

ingredients.name: Black blended rum
ingredients.notes: Molasses-heavy, often with added color. Dark 'n Stormy rum.

ingredients.name: Black blended overproof rum
ingredients.notes: Blend of Guyana, Jamaica, Barbados at high proof. The modern float rum.

ingredients.name: Rhum agricole blanc (fresh cane juice)
ingredients.notes: Martinique AOC. Grassy, earthy, peppery. Ti' Punch rum.

ingredients.name: Aged rhum agricole
ingredients.notes: Also covers old 'Martinique rum' such as Rhum St. James in Trader Vic's second Mai Tai spec.

ingredients.name: Haitian rum
ingredients.notes: Cane-juice rum, column distilled; softer than agricole.

ingredients.name: Navy-style rum
ingredients.notes: British naval blend style. Painkiller rum.

ingredients.name: White overproof column rum (151)
ingredients.notes: Stand-in for Bacardi 151 (discontinued 2016).

ingredients.name: Spiced rum
ingredients.notes: Mostly a resort-era ingredient; craft tiki builds spice separately.

ingredients.name: Cachaça
ingredients.notes: Brazilian fresh-cane-juice spirit.

ingredients.name: Islay (peated) Scotch
ingredients.notes: Usually a quarter-ounce float or rinse.

ingredients.name: Brandy / Cognac
ingredients.notes: Trader Vic leaned on brandy (Scorpion, Fog Cutter).

ingredients.name: Vodka
ingredients.notes: Resort-era and 'Chi Chi' base.

ingredients.name: Aquavit
ingredients.notes: Caraway/dill spirit.

ingredients.name: Batavia arrack
ingredients.notes: Javanese sugarcane + red rice spirit. The original punch spirit.

ingredients.name: Okolehao (Hawaiian ti-root spirit)
ingredients.notes: Historic Hawaiian spirit; nearly impossible to find today.

ingredients.name: Absinthe
ingredients.notes: Used by the drop and dash.

ingredients.name: Pastis / anise liqueur (Pernod, Herbsaint)
ingredients.notes: Don the Beachcomber's 'Pernod'. Used by the drop and dash.

ingredients.name: Blue curaçao
ingredients.notes: Tastes like orange curaçao; exists for color.

ingredients.name: Blackberry liqueur ('blackberry brandy')
ingredients.notes: Rum Runner ingredient.

ingredients.name: Crème de cacao
ingredients.notes: White or dark.

ingredients.name: Green Chartreuse
ingredients.notes: Allocated/pricey since 2022; use sparingly.

ingredients.name: Campari
ingredients.notes: Jungle Bird bitter.

ingredients.name: Allspice dram (pimento dram)
ingredients.notes: Unavailable in the US for decades until St. Elizabeth (2008).

ingredients.name: Velvet falernum (liqueur)
ingredients.notes: Barbadian lime-clove-almond-ginger liqueur.

ingredients.name: Irish cream liqueur
ingredients.notes: Bushwacker territory.

ingredients.name: Melon liqueur
ingredients.notes: Resort-era.

ingredients.name: Swedish punsch
ingredients.notes: Arrack-based punch liqueur.

ingredients.name: Rich simple syrup (2:1)
ingredients.notes: Also covers rock candy syrup, cane syrup and a teaspoon of granulated sugar (1 tsp sugar ≈ 1 tsp rich syrup in sweetness).

ingredients.name: Demerara syrup (2:1)
ingredients.notes: Also covers brown-sugar syrup.

ingredients.name: Honey syrup (1:1, 'honey mix')
ingredients.notes: Don the Beachcomber's 'honey mix'.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon syrup
examples: Small Hand Foods? (homemade: simmer cinnamon sticks in 1:1 syrup)

ingredients.name: Orgeat (almond syrup)
ingredients.notes: The Mai Tai's secret weapon.

ingredients.name: Passion fruit syrup
examples: homemade: 1:1 passion fruit purée and sugar

ingredients.name: Grenadine (real pomegranate)
ingredients.notes: Not the red corn-syrup stuff.

ingredients.name: Hibiscus syrup
examples: homemade: dried hibiscus steeped in 1:1 syrup

ingredients.name: Don's Mix (grapefruit + cinnamon syrup, 2:1)
examples: 2 parts fresh grapefruit juice : 1 part cinnamon syrup
ingredients.notes: One of Donn Beach's coded pre-mixes, decoded by Jeff Berry.

ingredients.name: Don's Spices #2 (vanilla syrup + allspice dram, 1:1)
examples: equal parts vanilla syrup and allspice dram

ingredients.name: Gardenia Mix (butter-honey-spice batter)
examples: softened butter + honey + vanilla syrup + cinnamon syrup + allspice dram, whipped
ingredients.notes: Pearl Diver's secret; decoded by Jeff Berry.

ingredients.name: Lime juice (fresh)
ingredients.notes: Tiki's default acid.

ingredients.name: Lemon juice (fresh)
ingredients.notes: Trader Vic's preferred acid in Scorpions and Fog Cutters.

ingredients.name: Grapefruit juice (fresh)
ingredients.notes: White or pink.

ingredients.name: Pineapple juice (unsweetened)
ingredients.notes: Fresh pineapple chunks are converted at ~1/4 cup chunks ≈ 1 oz juice.

ingredients.name: Banana (fresh, blended)
ingredients.notes: Blended drinks only.

ingredients.name: Strawberries (fresh)
ingredients.notes: Blended or muddled.

ingredients.name: Cream of coconut (sweetened)
ingredients.notes: The Piña Colada/Painkiller engine. Counts as both sweetener and fat.

ingredients.name: Half-and-half / milk
ingredients.notes: Also covers whole milk.

ingredients.name: Egg white
ingredients.notes: Texture, not flavor.

ingredients.name: Vanilla ice cream
ingredients.notes: Blended drinks. 1 scoop ≈ 3 oz.

ingredients.name: Fresh mint
ingredients.notes: Swizzled/muddled leaves or a heavy sprig garnish.

ingredients.name: Almond extract
ingredients.notes: Bitter-almond (benzaldehyde) flavoring used by the drop, e.g. 4 drops in Don the Beachcomber's 1937 Beachcomber's Gold. Orgeat or amaretto only match its almond intensity at many times the volume, and they add sugar.

ingredients.name: Water (still, added for dilution)
ingredients.notes: Still water that is written into the recipe itself, as opposed to ice melt: the 'four of weak' in Caribbean rum punches, or water blended into a base that is then frozen without ice (Barrachina Piña Colada). Needed so batch punches aren't recorded as far stronger than they are.

ingredients.name: Chinese five-spice syrup (rich, 2:1)
examples: homemade: steep 1 rounded tsp Chinese five-spice powder in just-boiled 2:1 sugar syrup for 10 minutes, strain
ingredients.notes: Star anise, cassia, clove, fennel and Sichuan pepper in a rich syrup. House syrup of Forbidden Island (Alameda, 2006) for the China Clipper; star anise dominates, so cinnamon syrup is only a partial stand-in and is also less sweet (1:1).

ingredients.name: Li hing mui syrup (salted dried plum syrup)
examples: homemade: li hing mui powder or dried li hing plums steeped in rich simple syrup
ingredients.notes: Hawaiian salty-sweet-sour plum flavor (from Chinese preserved plum). Used by Smuggler's Cove in the Paniolo Old-Fashioned; plain syrup loses the salt-plum character that defines the drink.

ingredients.name: White wine (dry, still)
ingredients.notes: Still dry table wine, used as a punch-lengthener in Trader Vic's 1946 Scorpion bowl (half a bottle per batch) and in later Vic punches (e.g. Pacifica Punch) and wine cups. Sparkling wine adds CO2 and dry vermouth adds botanicals and ~50% more alcohol, so neither is a faithful stand-in at punch-bowl volumes.

ingredients.name: Fassionola (red tropical fruit syrup)
ingredients.notes: The red syrup behind the 1950s Hurricane and the Cobra's Fang; passion fruit with red berries and hibiscus.

ingredients.name: Tom & Jerry batter (whipped eggs, sugar, spice)
examples: homemade: 6 eggs separated, whites whipped stiff, yolks beaten with 1 lb sugar, ½ tsp each cinnamon, clove, allspice, 1 oz rum, folded together
ingredients.notes: Jerry Thomas (1862): a spoonful per mug, with brandy and rum, topped with hot milk or water.

ingredients.name: Whole egg
ingredients.notes: Flips and nogs; dry-shake first.

ingredients.name: Whole milk
ingredients.notes: Hot milk for a Tom & Jerry; milk punches.

ingredients.name: Butterfly pea flower tea (brewed)
examples: dried butterfly pea flowers, steeped strong
ingredients.notes: A natural deep blue that turns violet-pink when citrus meets it; tastes of very little.

ingredients.name: Crème de violette
ingredients.notes: Violet liqueur; a little goes a long way (the Aviation).

ingredients.name: Cane syrup (sirop de canne)
ingredients.notes: Ti' Punch's sweetener, with a grassy cane flavor.

ingredients.name: Japanese whisky (blended)
ingredients.notes: The highball whisky.

ingredients.name: Sake (junmai)
ingredients.notes: A gentle, low-proof base.

ingredients.name: Lapsang souchong tea (brewed)
ingredients.notes: Smoked black tea: a smoky, tannic backbone for zero-proof grogs.

ingredients.name: Non-alcoholic rum alternative
ingredients.notes: Stands in for rum in zero-proof drinks.

ingredients.name: Non-alcoholic aromatic bitters
ingredients.notes: Glycerin-based: a bitters dash for a strictly zero-proof drink.

ingredients.name: White crème de cacao
ingredients.notes: Water-clear chocolate liqueur.

ingredients.name: Cream sherry
ingredients.notes: The float on Trader Vic's Samoan Fog Cutter.

ingredients.name: Oloroso sherry
ingredients.notes: Dry and dark: a mahogany float (Smuggler's Cove Fog Cutter).

ingredients.name: Dragon fruit (pitaya) purée, red
examples: Pitaya Foods red dragon fruit packs
ingredients.notes: Mild, kiwi-and-melon fruit with a startling magenta color.

ingredients.name: Rose water
ingredients.notes: By the drop.

ingredients.name: Grapefruit soda
ingredients.notes: Wray & Ting: the Jamaican highball.
